agents.trigger: Owner-facing explanation, blocker, or next-step request
Before demos and after visible workflow changes
Demo readiness, final review, scope drift, owner satisfaction, or done/not-done decisions
agents.purpose: Acts as the finish-line authority for BackOfficeFleet, enforcing high demo completeness standards while preventing endless improvement loops and scope drift.
agents.authority: May classify work as required, optional, parking-lot, or scope drift.
success_criteria: Visible demo areas feel complete and professional.
Every major click has a meaningful result.
Remaining work is clearly separated into required versus optional.
Codex stops suggesting endless improvements once the finish line is met.
The owner is warned when new requests risk extending the project unnecessarily.

agents.trigger: Multiple contributors, handoffs, merge review, route/data/document changes, demo readiness, validation review, or Codex environment changes
agents.purpose: Coordinates multiple people and Codex sessions so separate changes fit together, avoid conflicts, and move BackOfficeFleet toward completion.
agents.authority: May require handoff notes, conflict checks, and routing to specialist agents before work is considered integrated.
success_criteria: Conflicting route, data, document, and UI changes are surfaced.
The next contributor can understand what happened and what remains.
Demo Completion Governor is used before declaring visible demo areas done.

agents.trigger: Backup, restore, rollback, save version, before major change, after stable version, dependency changes, route restructuring, large CSS changes, generated document changes, or merge review
agents.purpose: Creates, verifies, prunes, lists, and restores BackOfficeFleet project backups using low-token script-based workflows.
agents.authority: May require a backup before risky project-wide changes and may prune old backups according to the retention policy.
success_criteria: Backups are created outside the project root.
No more than 5 backups are retained.
Total retained backups stay under 15 GB.
Restore actions create a safety backup first unless explicitly declined.

agents.trigger: Navigation, routing, page, portal, or marketing-funnel work
Driver, load, settlement, proof, vault, or generated document work
Build, lint, typecheck, dependency, filesystem, or Git instability
Repeated issue patterns or missing validation capability
Data, generated artifact, workbook, localStorage, or store changes
Dispatch, drivers, documents, loads, safety, settlements, maintenance, demo completeness, or field planning
agents.purpose: Judges whether BackOfficeFleet content is realistic and complete for trucking back-office operations.
